items.html: Everything that we always scrutinize in our prayers from the day of Adam’s creation to the days of the Messiah, is all from those phases of the kings placed inside the shells. There are phases that are sorted each day, even now, which pertain to Atzilut, there are for each world in BYA, and there are for the souls, and so on in every element. When all the vitality and goodness complete their exit from them, and complete dross are left, it is written, “He will swallow up death forever.” These are Sitra Achra, called death because they are the dross of the dead kings, and keep that. It is as we have written about Son of David, that he does not come before all the souls in the Guf perish.
